visual_observation.scope: The workshop remains visibly rendered in all four local RTS views. This is not broad perceptual-equivalence certification.

conclusion.reason: Two separate GitHub-hosted runs produced materially different timing deltas: the first looked about 26-27% lower in four-seat install time, while the fresh repeat was approximately flat. Runner-to-runner timing variance is therefore large enough that no reliable speedup claim is supported.
conclusion.next_focus: Keep the structurally correct shared-resource path, but pursue deeper geometry LODs and target-device measurement rather than advertising CI install-time improvement.

nonclaims: GitHub-hosted headless timing is not target-device performance certification.
Shared JavaScript/Three.js object identity does not prove shared GPU residency or reduced GPU memory.
The first faster run is retained as evidence but is not promoted over the contradictory repeat.
This receipt does not establish FPS acceptance, final material/texture budgets, or broad LOD visual equivalence.
